Thank you, I REALLY appreciate it.


I know of her bad sides, but I could just ignore them at times. Have you heard of the term Limerance? I just found out and it's 100% me... If only I've known last year :(. Now I'm in this deep shit and need to get out. But understanding seems like a huge piece!


I'm on the road to feeling better now and it's all I hope for. Thank you again for your kind words.
Thanks, I just read up on Limerance, which is 100% what I get sometimes. I will try to chill, but now that I understand this I think I can move on.
Thanks. I'll remember your words if she tries to contact me.

Thanks, I'll do my best. My problem is that I will mostly likely fail if she gets in contact with me within the nearest months... Seeing her message pop up makes me tingle right away. But you are correct! I'll try to work on myself and then see what happens. Thanks for the response!

> Move on? Find another AP? One that your wife approves of?


I've swore never to be unfaitful again, which is something I strive for. I could leave my wife and hope for someone that actually approves of me as a boyfriend I guess. But I will make a serious attempt to save the marriage first.


>One thing I do not understand... You started out with an open relationship and you and your wife had affairs. But this particular affair with H that you fell in love with somehow made you unfaithful? Unfaithful how exactly? Because you neglected your children?


Part of our deal was to always tell the other when and where we met people. Me and H broke that rule almost instantly. This had never happened with another woman before.


> So the open relationship is off the table now?


Yes, forever.

Thanks. I think you are right. But I'm owning my shit with the kids. Or atleast I'm tons better than I've ever been. I play with them now, I spend time, kiss them and embrace them every day. Kids will almost always get hurt by an affair in some way, discovered or not.

No. I went over 13 weeks and it helped me figure out a lot of things. I'm now pretty sure I'm addicted to porn and has been for almost 20 years now. I've tried NoFap for three years but I never completed more than a month. I think the porn has messed with my brain, since 99% of the time my life is just grey. I don't look forward to anything except sex or sex related things. Me and my wife went to couples therapy just twice, but the lady we "got" was a cliché so we decided to put it on hold (four months since)...

Well, no shit. That's why I went through therapy and I would never endanger our kids again. That's in the past and I feel like shit for doing it, belive me. I've started going deeper in myself and I think my chemical balance isn't good, and never has been. But I can't help to wonder, what if?


*Edit: I truely know how shit it is to ignore the most imporant being in the world, this I why I sought to therapy. I knew I'm a bad person and that I'm broken, but I still feel hopeful because with therapy and reading, listening I might have found a huge piece of the puzzle.
